description: Signal réseau Guadeloupe - Recharge véhicule électrique is a dataset listed in KaruData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by EDF-SEI. Les spécificités du système électrique insulaire de la Guadeloupe incitent à prendre des précautions concernant le développement de la mobilité électrique. Coverage: Guadeloupe. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements, Environnement. Its keywords are Recharge véhicules électriques, Smart charging, Signal, Réseau. The portal shows 52,560 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2023-03-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-karudata-com-portal.
